title: Understanding the Expectation
text: The expectation in the bias-variance decomposition is taken over the randomness in the data and the randomness in the model fitting process. Consider what sources of randomness are involved in these processes.

title: Sources of Randomness
text: Think about the different sources of randomness that can affect the outcome of a model. Are errors in data collection one of these sources?

title: Identifying the Correct Source
text: Consider whether the expectation is taken over the randomness in the data collection process or the randomness in the model fitting process.
